notes.title: Hard Bullet Demo is here!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33018960/7c944e672ee9e192b3c999fc3635ae4121db2a15.png[/img]
We've been working hard on this new [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1294760/Hard_Bullet/]VR game [b]Hard Bullet[/b][/url] and now want to gather your feedback.

Shoot, kick, destroy, jump, fly, push, blow up and — most important — have fun in this timekilling unstoppable action game!

Visit the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1294760/Hard_Bullet/]Store Page[/url] or [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/gamefestival?tab=12]Steam Festival[/url] to get a Demo and start a mess!

[h1]Max Payne and F.E.A.R. -inspired gameplay[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33018960/ff06c242693b888dc4dd10ca75d6988adc4854bc.png[/img]
We always wanted to bring classic PC blockbusters feeling to VR gaming, so expect yourself to jump, slide, do wall jumps and all this in slow motion!

Made with a special attention for dual wielding gunplay so expect various submachine guns, pistols and shotguns. You'll find classic rifles as well.

[h1]Destructions and Physics[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33018960/b7fdf0f691b4d4fefad1099ee3b98d282b4de876.png[/img]
Inspired by genre-defining classic John Woo movies like [b]Hard Boiled, The Killer, Better Tomorrow, Hard Target[/b]

We worked out the best solutions to bring realistic physic destructions and created dozens of unique assets to fill the arenas. Classic locations to mess everything up: offices, warehouses, laboratories.


[h1]Current Demo Limitations[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33018960/404c28e602f4aad36494bcc7113fcdc68655856c.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Please, notice, this is only a Demo Beta Test and does not represent the final Hard Bullet experience.  
[*] No tutorial. Working on it.
[*] Weapons: No auto-reloading animations. No customization and limited interactions. Only a few types available.
[*] Enemy AI: Two enemy characters with a very basic intellect.
[*] Interaction: Limited character interaction. Object interaction is turned off.
[*] [b]Gore and dismemberment are turned off. Blood only.[/b]
[*] Realtime lighting and shadows are turned off.
[*] Inventory: Gun holsters are turned off.
[*] Sounds: Most of them are placeholders or not balanced yet.
[*] Grenades and explosions are turned off.
[/list]


[h1]Join our Discord[/h1]

Talk directly to the devs, share your opinion and ideas with us!
[url=https://discord.gg/QDrUWsJ]Joining Discord[/url] will help you to stay on Beta Test after the Festival.

Probably we'll turn the [b]Hard Bullet Demo[/b] off and will release an updated version after a while.
To stay on the latest Demo build you can join the Beta Test through our [url=https://discord.gg/QDrUWsJ]Discord Server[/url].

[h1]Wishlist and Follow us on Steam![/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33018960/208d04ca37e1a89ae0f5446221d35143377da41a.gif[/img]
Add Hard Bullet Steam Page to your wishlist so you'll be ready when it comes.

Steam Forums Feedback

Visit Hard Bullet Steam Discussion Forums and share your feedback there with us!


[url=https://discord.gg/QDrUWsJ]DISCORD[/url] [url=https://twitter.com/GexagonVR]TWITTER[/url] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1294760/Hard_Bullet/]STEAM[/url]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33018960/9a303a89cb6a0c91c4336acba17ed3d05ccdd550.png[/img]

notes.title: Updates and PC/Mac release
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28822542/6a8e21c82034d071e37735bd90ae9931144cf772.jpg[/img]

Hi, this week we launched our first non-VR game on Steam — Qbike: Crypto Motorcycles:

[url]http://store.steampowered.com/app/713610/Qbike_Crypto_Motorcycles/[/url]

For all VR users, this brings more players online and ability to get yourself a standalone version through [url=store.steampowered.com/bundle/4664/Qbike_PC_vs_VR/]PC vs VR Bundle[/url] with an awesome [b]20% discount[/b]!

You can play on your Windows, MacOS X and Linux devices. Qbike is really well optimised so even low-end machines will run it.

[h1]Updates:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Reworked collision scenarios were both bikers got destroyed in duels. Now bikes will hit with some force but survive you or not will depend only on you.
[*]Smasher hitbox increased. It's much easier now to destroy the opponent by falling on him.
[*]French Language added.
[*]Updated some translations.
[/list]

notes.title: Team Deathmatch and other Updates
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28822542/3c620856401b690de5207b683fe0c7b9cc4401ac.jpg[/img]
[h1]New Deathmatch mode[/h1]
Added Team Deathmatch for those who like to play together as a team.
You can start 2v2 games in Red or Green team. Both Long and Short trail mods are supported.

Some UI images are not finished yet, but everything in the game works fine.

[h1]Multilanguage Update[/h1]
With great community help, we made translations to 8 world languages, here they are:
[list]
[*] Chinese 
[*] Czech by Petr Valis r/u/Twisp56
[*] Dutch
[*] Portu-Brazil 
[*] Russian 
[*] German 
[*] Korean by Bumchul Kim r/u/MinimalResults
[*] Spanish
[/list]
We believe there could be some bugs/misspelling so if you have noticed a bug or bad translation — [url=steamcommunity.com/app/614970/discussions/0/1519260397779610613/]leave your feedback here[/url] to help make it better.

We still need help with French, Italian, and Japanese translations, so if you can help us — feel free to contact.

[h1]Big Sound Update[/h1]
We added tens of new SFX and reworked those we already had. 

This sound work just started, so expect minor sound updates during the development without special announcements.

[h1]Minor Updates:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Reworked Main Menu logic so it's whole new thing inside for us and very much the same for you.
[*]Updated Demo Languages.
[*]Prepaired QbikeVR for cross-platform with PC, Mac, Linux.
[/list]

[h1]Join us to improve Qbike:[/h1]
[url=discord.gg/JXFTKng]Official Qbike Discord Channel[/url]
[url=steamcommunity.com/app/614970/discussions/0/1470840994963343696/]Steam Discussions[/url]

GexagonVR Team

notes.content:
The third week of Qbike on Steam has passed, here are the new features to enjoy:
[h1]New Motion Controlls for steering[/h1]
[u][b]To Turn On go to the Settings and change CONTROL to Controllers.[/b][/u]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28822542/5793c2b547e3e18cce34d8f6e4f055eea5659b42.jpg[/img]

[url=steamcommunity.com/games/614970/announcements/detail/2655289694745826627]You can get more information how it works in this announcement[/url]

[h1]Lobby Cameras[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28822542/5918a0f351f2d92826904d1005e54e7732f53113.jpg[/img]

Now you can watch the race from the lobby while waiting for next round or prepairing to join deathmatch.

You can switch between 1st/3rd person and flying camera.

[h1]Other last week updates:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Moved to Unity 2017: new effects and perfomance boost.
[*] User Interface optimization.
[*] Fixed Round restart/rematch bug in Long Trail.

notes.title: New Motion Controlls
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28822542/88cac684c519f518534166cca0ead15b272471a7.jpg[/img]

We continue to work on new controll setups on the way to simulate real quantum-powered cyberpunk motorcycle riding experience.

In this update we trying to implement some hand steering controlls, without making it too hard or annoying.

When you switch to Controllers in the Settings menu your bike becomes affected by your Motion Controllers position.

[b]The lower one controller is accordingly to the other one — the stronger turn you will make.[/b]

You can hold your hands in the air (quiet hard to hold them for the long time) or just place them on your knees and slightly move up or down  when you need.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28822542/5793c2b547e3e18cce34d8f6e4f055eea5659b42.jpg[/img]

[h1]Please, leave your feedback to make Qbike better:[/h1]
[url=discord.gg/JXFTKng]Official Qbike Discord Channel[/url]
[url=steamcommunity.com/app/614970/discussions/0/1470840994963343696/]Steam Discussions[/url]

GexagonVR Team

[url=steamcommunity.com/app/614970/discussions/0/1470840994963343696/]Steam Discussions[/url]

notes.title: Hours before EA
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28822542/82799859124c0c379e6994c1bea437eeed6caa7a.jpg[/img]
Hi, we want to introduce to you the new core features of the Qbike Cyberpunk Motorcycles.

During the Match (deathmatch it is for now) players will be able to earn Performance Points and get to the Global Leaderboards.

[h1]Leaderboards and Performance Points[/h1]

While we are testing and balancing new skills, you can start practicing in earning points! When the skill set is finished, Performance Points will help you to unlock and upgrade new player abilities.

Your points amount, total wins and kills scores will be added to world wide Qbike Leaderboards. 
We plan to upgrade and add more interesting statistics during the development. 

[h1]Score Multiplicator[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28822542/599c41004e001e79453e4cae0543d98caba31c62.jpg[/img]
You can raise your PP by performing various tricks and challenges during the race.

Every time you earn 100 PP you receive 1 bar to your total power multiplicator.

Every level will multiply your race score until you die. To reach next Multiplicator level you'll need to complete challenges again, but you'll receive more points accordingly to the current Multiplicator level.

[h1]Current Challenges Available[/h1]

We are going to update and expand this list during EA.

[b]The following Challenges add one Multiplicator bar:[/b]
[list]
[*]Destroying player's bike gives you 200 points
[*]Ride under Ark — Sneak under Barrier Arch to get 50 points
[*]Maneuver —  gives 100 points when fast-killing opponent with your barrier
[*]Air Time — starts after one second is spent in the air
[*]Drift Time — you can achieve this by making a fast turn before the jump
[*]Close Call — gives 50 points every moment while riding close to the opponent
[/list]

[b]The following Challenges give you bonus scores in the end and during the match:[/b]
[list]
[*]Kills in a row give you 50 on the second, 100 on the third, 150 on the 4th and so on
[*]Air Kill gives you 100 bonus points
[*]First place — 100 points
[*]Win without using Abilities — 100 points
[*]Win the match — 100 points
[*]Never die during the race  — 100 points
[/list]

[h1]The nearest Updates:[/h1]
[url=steamcommunity.com/app/614970/discussions/0/1470840994963362061/]Full Roadmap Here[/url]

[b]Different Controls setups[/b]
We are working on new controllers scheme where you can control the bike with your own hands like IRL. Looking into "steering with your body" option.

[b]Dedicated Servers.[/b] 
In fact, the only thing which separates us from this goal is our budget. Hope it improves soon!

[b]Carrier/Decent Single Player mode[/b]. 
We want to tell you Qbike story so you can get the full vision of this future world where the New Gold Rush transforms crypto miners into cyberpunk racers.

notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28822542/7ff98cb64f85f77845f39e1977f281c512c285b5.jpg[/img]

[h1]Beta keys called back before Early Access[/h1]

We called back all the Qbike Beta test keys. Thank you for your interest. Hope we've  brought you some fun and memorable moments during these weeks.
Coming to Early Access is a big thing for us and we still need your help in developing Qbike. Leave your feedback in our Steam Groups so we can make this game better!

[h1]Demo Updates[/h1]

Qbike demo will be updated up to the current EA version with some limitations.
Deathmatch multiplayer will be removed. All PvP and Co-Op modes now move to Early Access.

That doesn't mean Demo users will be left on the edge of XXII's century crypto gold rush. You'll need all your experience to get to World Leaderboards by accomplishing Daily Skill Challenges!

[url=steamcommunity.com/games/614970/announcements/detail/1434812197938598987]You can find more details about Challenges in this Announcement[/url]

notes.title: 1# Beta Week Updates
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28822542/c6f10eecb959d0a6a1171fe93f16d60d6d6bc97c.jpg[/img]

Hi, first of all — big thanks to everyone who is taking part in this beta test.
We are gathering a lot of feedback and useful information. 

[b]Qbike Beta Updates[/b]:
[list]
[*] Voice Chat added! It's turned ON by default. You can find more options in the Setting menu.
[*] Improved Trail Colliders system. Now you can sneak through really tight places with no harm.
[*] Improved Drift. There was a chance to kill yourself when accidentally colliding with your own trail.
[*] Fixed when a player could stay alive when his bike is destroyed.
[*] Fixed Restart/Ready button issue. Will keep an eye on it though.
[*] Fixed colliders at Quad map (when you could run into a wall and stay alive).
[*] Fixed and synchronized all the timers so no more unexpected respawns in Long Trail mode
[/list]

Keep your Qbike Beta up to date and have fun!

If you haven't participated yet, use this [url=docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSedK4Y1ieZV8IvjwaGYfDC0KcGSQm9OWxMML68eT3JdSm23ww/viewform?usp=sf_link] QBIKE BETA SING UP FORM[/url] to join us!

Hello, cyber moto racers!

Follow the link above to get your Beta Key and join us on Cyberpunk Photon arenas on your own Qbike!

Beta is FREE for everyone.

We are testing VR functions, so you'll need a VR headset to play. 

In the current state, you'll be able:
[list]
[*]Online Multiplayer
[*]Two Deathmatch types
[*]Various comfort options
[*]Play on three different maps
[*]Three bikes to ride
[*]Two skills with a short cooldown
[/list]

notes.title: Infinite Trail mode
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28822542/fb66c074c7cdaf089f784d6608a723cf46a75254.jpg[/img]

[h1]Hi, we finished working on Infinite Trail mode.[/h1]

When you choose this play mode your and your opponents' Qbikes will spawn an endless barrier which will disappear only when the player dies.

So after a couple of minutes, the map is filled with deadly traps and dangerous walls to avoid. Watch yourself and use your abilities to avoid death.

In this mode, you will set the number of rounds to play. Round is finished when only one player is left.

The last man standing is the winner.

When you die, you teleport to the lounge zone to watch the race from the top until the new round starts.

[h1]Wishlist and Follow Qbike to keep informed about the progress. 
Early Access is coming this month![/h1]
 
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28822542/b6f46de426987c203677dbd8115a57f543a96bd2.jpg[/img]
